park.reason: Read the triage findings and the recommendation in story.md (also posted on the issue). N is the issue number. Switch to a workflow: `norn workflow gh-N fix --to reproduce`, `norn workflow gh-N quick --to implement`, `norn workflow gh-N story --to refine` or `norn workflow gh-N spec --to refine`. Close: `norn approve gh-N --reason "<why>"`, then `gh issue close N --reason "not planned"`, then `norn drop gh-N` (a story at $done without a PR otherwise waits for a merge, GR6), then `git push origin --delete gh-N-<slug>` (drop pushed the story branch; the findings stay on the issue comment). Triage again: `norn approve gh-N --reject --reason "<what to look at>"`.
